name: City St George's, University of London
description:
The City University of London is a public research university in London, United Kingdom. It was founded in 1894 as the Northampton Institute, with the Inns of Court School of Law being established in 1852. University status was granted in 1966 but the merging of the university and school did not occur until 2001.

More than 170 countries are represented in the student body at City University of London as the establishment attracts alumni from all around the world. The university has strong links with the City of London and the Lord Mayor of London, with the main campus being located in Islington. With a strong alumni portfolio, including a Founding Father, leading politicians, Prime Ministers of the United Kingdom, governors and CEOs, it has a reputation for excellence.

What is the City University of London acceptance rate for International Students?

The City University of London acceptance rate is 12%.

Research support can be accessed online or in person, plus workshops are held to sharpen a studentâ€™s research skills. The university also houses the city law school, Bayes business school, and the schools of: science & technology, health & psychological sciences, policy & global affairs, communication & creativity.

Student Life

Students enjoy a fulfilling experience on the City University of London campus. The campus is situated in Northampton Square in Londonâ€™s infamous Knowledge Quarter, just a short journey from the financial quarter of the city. There are numerous spaces in which to socialise, study solo or get involved with student societies. The student union at the university is affiliated with the national union of students and actively involved in lobbying on local and national policy issues. There are a number of law societies, a journalism and photography club, plus a number of special interest groups such as a K-pop and motorsports club.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: City St George's, University of London, was formed by the merger of City, University of London and St George's, University of London in August 2024. Here, you'll get to experience the best of both institutions. With a diverse range of programs, the university offers undergraduate and postgraduate courses, particularly in health, business, engineering, and arts and media, helping you excel in various fields.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value:
At City St George's, University of London, you’ll join a vibrant student body that represents more than 170 countries. The university attracts alumni from all around the world, creating a truly global community. When it comes to social life, City St George’s Students’ Union provides you with various social and academic opportunities. There are plenty of student-led clubs and societies that you can join to meet people from around the world.

As a student, you’ll also benefit from the university’s affiliation with the National Union of Students (NUS). Plus, the university provides counselling and specialised services for students with disabilities and neurodiversity.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The university offers affordable halls near the campuses. As a first-year undergraduate, you're usually assured a room in the halls if you meet the criteria and deadline. Near the Clerkenwell campus, you’ll find a range of halls available, accessible by walk or a short commute. You’ll also get many housing options at Horton Halls, close to the Tooting campus.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
City St George's has 3 libraries across its campuses: Northampton Square, Law Library at Sebastian Street, and Business Library at Bunhill Row. These libraries provide a wide range of print and online resources, study spaces, and networked PCs.

Sports
City St George's offers you diverse sporting facilities. CityActive, their social sports program, helps you connect with others through sports you enjoy. You can also represent the university in competitive matches against other London universities. For individual fitness, modern facilities like the CitySport Gym are available.

Laboratory
At City St George's, you’ll find numerous research centres spanning various subjects and schools. These cover a wide range of fields, including accounting, advanced composites, aeronautics and aerospace, artificial intelligence, and many more.
